name: Main Gate
description: The noisy front of campus where keke drivers, hawkers, and campus security all talk at the same time.

name: Hostel Block A
description: Your room, your chaos, your generator-adjacent survival strategy.

name: Faculty Lecture Hall
description: Long benches, bad AC, and a lecturer who is either an angel or a threat depending on the day.

name: Library
description: Cold air, silent tables, and the only place with decent Wi-Fi when the network is behaving.

name: Cafeteria
description: A long queue, boiled rice, and the smell of stew that makes everyone forget their stress for 15 minutes.

name: Mama Put Food Joint
description: Noisy, cheap, and always full of the kind of stories you wish you hadn't heard.

name: Business Centre
description: Printing, photocopying, POS, and a man who charges extra if you ask for 'urgent' service.

name: Sports Field
description: A patch of grass where football arguments, exercise, and campus gossip all happen at once.

name: Student Union Building
description: Screening room, meeting point, politics hub, and a place where a rumour can become law by 4pm.

name: Under-the-Tree Hangout
description: Shaded seating, cheap soft drinks, and a daily audience for the campus drama of the hour.
